title: Seven Activists Liberate 16 Broiler Hens (Argentina)
content:
Received anonymously: (translated)

For politicians, the justice system and those who profit from animal life, there is a difference between an animal being killed in a slaughterhouse to sell its body and generate capital, or starving to death on farms — this represents a loss of invested capital.

For us, every individual life has value, so we only have one chance, and we won’t waste it waiting for the justice system to decide. Nor shall we waste her begging for mercy and for her murderers to give us a life.

And there we are, in broad daylight, in full view of some curious onlookers, cutting through the plastic to give them freedom, the freedom they have been denied since the moment they were born.

We only care about each other so they can be free, because they only have us by their side to break the cage.

Sete ativistas libertam 16 frangos de corte

Para os políticos, o sistema judiciário e aqueles que lucram com a vida animal, há uma diferença entre um animal ser morto em um matadouro para vender seu corpo e gerar capital, ou morrer de fome em fazendas — isso representa uma perda de capital investido.

Para nós, cada vida individual tem valor, então só temos uma chance, e não vamos desperdiçá-la esperando que o sistema judiciário decida.

Nem vamos desperdiçá-la implorando por misericórdia e para que seus assassinos nos deem uma vida. E lá estamos nós, em plena luz do dia

title: Dixon Mink Farm in Bluffdale, Utah will be Forced to Close
content:
Dixon Mink Farm at 15028 Pony Express Road in the town of Bluffdale, Utah will be forced to close.

The city council of Bluffdale has eliminated fur farming as a permitted use. Fur farms will be unable to operate in Bluffdale.

The councilperson who pushed for the change said:

“I saw the serious issue the mink farm had on the lives of our residents. As I knocked on doors of our independence area there were so many flies people couldn’t open their door to talk to me. Because of this ordinance change the city can not approve the business license for this or any other mink farm.”

title: Beagles Liberated at MBR Beagles in UK (Cambridgeshire)
content: According to Camp Beagle, people accessed MBR Acres on the 29th of September and liberated multiple dogs. At least three dogs were rescued, but there is potential of more dogs being liberated. One person stayed back after the raid and was arrested by the police.
